EXAMPLECO INC.

CURRENT REPORT Pursuant to Section 13 or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934

Date of Report (Date of earliest event reported): March 15, 2023

Item 4.01 Changes in Registrant's Certifying Accountant.

On March 13, 2023, the Audit Committee of the Board of Directors of ExampleCo Inc. dismissed Smith & Jones LLP as the Company's independent registered public accounting firm, effective immediately. The reports of Smith & Jones LLP on the Company's consolidated financial statements for the fiscal years ended 2022 and 2021 did not contain an adverse opinion or a disclaimer of opinion. On March 14, 2023, the Audit Committee engaged Brown & Partners LLP as the Company's new independent registered public accounting firm for the fiscal year ending 2023.
